Title: Need to widen National Highway No. 209 from Dindigul to Bengaluru. 

SHRI M. UDHAYA KUMAR (DINDIGUL): Hon. Deputy-Speaker, thank you for allowing me to raise an important matter in this august House. 

National Highway, NH 209, falls entirely within the State of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. In Tamil Nadu, it covers 286 kms. and in Karnataka it covers 170 Kms. The Highway is maintained by the National Highways Authority of India. This Highway links Dindigul with Bengaluru. It runs for a distance of 456 kms. This National Highway passes through Dindigul – Pollachi – Palani – Coimbatore – Annur – Kollegal – Bengaluru. 

Currently NH 209 is in a bad condition. It has numerous curves which pose a threat to the motorists.

The initial proposal is to widen the 200 kms. stretch into a four-lane road. The project has two sections, from Dindigul to Coimbatore and from Coimbatore to Karnataka border. The proposal includes four major bridges, 30 minor bridges, vehicular and passenger underpasses, road over bridges and as many as six bypass roads between Dindigul and Coimbatore. The proposal is to have service lanes in some areas where there were major towns or cities. Flow of traffic is high on the existing two-lane stretch between Dindigul and Palani and also from Coimbatore to Udumalapet and widening of the road will ensure smooth flow of traffic.

Even as there is increasing demand to widen National Highway 209 from Dindigul to Bengaluru, the National Highways Authority of India is expecting the consultant to finalise and submit the feasibility report for the project in a couple of months. The NHAI is pursuing the matter and waiting for the final feasibility report for a long period. Also there is a proposal for extending this Highway as NH 209 – A, which splits from Sathy towards Erode via Gobi and reaches Dindigul via Sivagiri, Aravakkurichi. 

I urge upon the National Highways Authority of India to speed up widening of National Highway 209 connecting Bengaluru and Dindigul via Chamarajanagar and Coimbatore. Thank you.

Title: Regarding 'Walk of Hope: by Sri M (Sri Madhukarnath Ji). 

श्री गणेश सिंह (सतना) : उपाध्यक्ष महोदय, आपका बहुत बहुत धन्यवाद। मैं आपके माध्यम से सदन का ध्यान एक आशा यात्रा, जो कन्याकुमारी से शुरू हुई है और कश्मीर तक जाने वाली है, उसकी ओर दिलाना चाहता हूँ। देश में शान्ति एवं सद्भाव को लेकर श्री एम, जो कि एक मुस्लिम परिवार में 6 नवम्बर, 1948 को तिरुवनंतपुरम में जन्मे थे, वे एक आध्यात्मिक गुरू, समाज सुधारक व शिक्षाविद् हैं। वे 19 वर्ष की अवस्था में योगी हो गये थे, उन्होंने हिमालय में तप किया। उन्होंने कन्याकुमारी से कश्मीर तक की 7500 किलोमीटर की पदयात्रा 12 जनवरी, 2015 को शुरू की है, जो 18 माह में पूरी होगी। इस यात्रा का नाम आशा यात्रा है, जो देश में 11 राज्यों से गुजरेगी। इस यात्रा का जगह-जगह अत्यन्त स्वागत हो रहा है और सभी धर्मों के लोग उन्हें मिल रहे हैं। 

एक तरफ विपक्ष देश में असहिष्णुता फैल रही है, ऐसा दुप्रचार करने में लगा हुआ है। ऐसे समय में श्री एम जी ने सर्वधर्म समभाव का तथा प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी द्वारा चलाये जा रहे अखण्ड भारत - स्वच्छ भारत, स्वस्थ भारत - शिक्षित भारत, बेटी पढ़ाओ - बेटी बचाओ का संदेश लेकर राष्ट्रव्यापी आशा यात्रा कर रहे हैं। मैं उनको सफल यात्रा की शुभकामनाएं देता हूं और संसद से भी ऐसी यात्रा के बारे में मैं चाहूंगा कि अपनी शुभकामनाएं दे। धन्यवाद।

Title: Need to formulate an effective price control and regulation policy to fix the prices of both petrol and diesel. 

SHRI G. HARI (ARAKKONAM): Hon. Deputy-Speaker, Sir, I thank you for calling me to raise an important issue.

International crude oil prices have fallen from US $ 116 per barrel in July 2014 to US $ 45 at present. But the Oil Marketing Companies in India have not reduced the prices of petrol/diesel matching with the fall in international prices. To match with the fall in international prices, the prices of both petrol and diesel should have been reduced. The Oil Marketing Companies take independent decision on petrol/diesel prices without even bothering to discuss with the Government. This is not at all good for both the Government and the people.

Hon. Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Puratchithalaivi Amma has demanded that Union Government should instruct the petroleum companies to withdraw the rise in petrol and diesel prices and effect a rollback immediately to pass on the real benefits of falling international crude oil prices to the consumers. It is high time the Union Government formulated and effected a price control and regulation policy and insist on the oil marketing companies to strictly adhere to it while fixing the price of petrol and diesel. 

I, therefore, urge upon the Union Government to formulate an effective price control and regulation policy and to stop the unilateral decisions made by the Oil Marketing Companies to benefit the consumers.

Title: Need to expedite the construction of outer Ring Road in Madurai city.

 traditional city having potential to grow manifold in the coming 
 years. The popular Meenakshi Amman Temple draws lakhs of

 Madurai well deserves to have all the hi-tech and updated 
 infrastructure facilities. Construction of the Outer Ring Road

 infrastructures. Madurai city is called as Thoonga Nagaram, a 
 city that never sleeps. Such is the movement of traffic and 
 people there.

title: Need to allocate adequate funds to create awareners about soil health among farmers in Tamil Nadu. 

SHRI K. PARASURAMAN (THANJAVUR): Hon. Speaker Madam, Under the able guidance of our hon. Chief Minister Puratchi Thalaivi Amma, I would like to draw the attention to the Minister of Agriculture with regard to soil resource. In order to preserve soil resources awareness cause in the world, the United Nations Director for Food and Agriculture Organisation, Jose Graziano Tacilva had announced that the year of 2015 is declared as the "World Soil Resource Day". Every Year, December 5th is celebrated as a World Soil Day. On that day we all take our responsibility to ensure protection of soil resources.

Soil contains 25 percent air, 25 percent water, 45 percent minerals and 5 per cent bacteria. To form the surface of the 2.5 depth's soil, thousand of years is required. It is good to see flourish and blooming in agriculture. Depending on the top of the soil, crop reaches the yield. Crores of bacteria, lakhs of Actinomyces bacteria are living on the top of the soil. Sir, in 1.4 tonne per acre crop land earthworms live. Earthworms create rich soil to the tune of 15 tonne per year. In India , 45 percent of the land is used for cultivation.

Our hon. Prime Minister launched the "Soil Health Card Scheme" for the benefit of the farmers in India. This step to issue Soil Health Cards to farmers will ensure that they are aware of the quality of soil so that they can use right fertilizers.

Our hon. Chief Minister Puratchi Thalaivi Amma implemented many pioneering schemes in Tamil Nadu like the Social Security Scheme for Farmers and their Dependent Family Members of Farmers. This scheme is offering various welfare benefits to farmers.

Hence, in order to preserve the soil resource, I humbly request the Central Government to allot adequate funds to create awareness about soil health among farmers in Tamil Nadu.

Title: Need to take necessary ateps to permit importing apples from foreign countries by Chennai Port Trust and all the Port Trusts in India. 

SHRI P.R. SENTHILNATHAN (SIVAGANGA): Thank you, Deputy-Speaker, Sir. I would like to bring an important issue to the notice of the House through this august House. 

Apple is the king of fruits. At the end of the season at Kashmir, apple is imported from foreign countries. That is the only way to fulfil the demands of the Indian consumers. Up to September, 2015, apple was imported to India through various ports like Chennai port, Mumbai port etc. 

Nowadays, import of apple from Chennai Port Trust is banned by the Government. The import of apple is only allowed through the Mumbai Port. 

Imported apples are being transported to other parts of the country, including Chennai, by lorries and other modes of transport. This process involves additional cost, which is impacting the common man. 

The Chennai Port Trust is not allowed to import apples from abroad. In the absence of the Chennai Port Trust being allowed to import apples, the traders are put to hardships. Since apple is a perishable commodity, the traders have to bring it to the consumers early so that they do not suffer loss on account of wastage.

Hence, I would request the Government of India to look into matter seriously and permit the Chennai Port Trust to import apples straight from abroad.

Except Mumbai Port Trust, all the other Ports in India are banned importing apples from foreign countries. So, the Government should take necessary steps to permit importing apples from foreign countries by all the Port Trusts in India. 

Thank you.

The river Netravati is the life line of Dakshina Kannada district of Karnataka. The project if implemented would badly affect the Western Ghats which is recognized as world heritage site. Western Ghats is the home of numerous flora and fauna. They are already facing threats from industries and urbanization. It is the need of the hour to preserve and conserve the Western Ghats. There are protests against this proposed drinking water project not only from the people of Dakshina Kannada district but also from the environmentalists. In the beginning the name of the drinking water project was "Scheme for diversion of flood water from Sakaleshpur (West) to Kolar/Chikkaballapura (East)," the Government of Karnataka has renamed it as Yettinahole drinking water project in order to convince the Union Environment Ministry to get the clearance for the project.

I would like to point out that the State Government has not taken the consent of the farmers to acquire the land for the project. This is a clear violation of Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013. Further, the Government of Karnataka has not conducted any study to analyse the pros and cons of the project. It has taken unilateral decision to spend Rs.13,000 crores on the controversial water project. Therefore, I urge upon the Union Government to seek immediate explanation from the Government of Karnataka and also issue a direction to stop the project without any delay.

Title: Need to take stringent action against the organizations which are collecting money from foreign countries in the name of physically challenged persons. 

श्री शरद त्रिपाठी (संत कबीर नगर): उपाध्यक्ष महोदय, इस बात की लगातार शिकायतें मिल रही हैं कि गैर-सरकारी संगठनों के द्वारा देश और विदेश में विकलांगों के नाम पर चंदे की उगाही की जा रही है। डब्ल्यूएचओ की रिपोर्ट भी आ चुकी है भारत इस समय पोलियो से मुक्त हो चुका है। यह अत्यंत ही खेद का विषय है कि अपने ही देश का नारायण सेवा संगठन इतनी धनराशि देश और विदेश से जुटा लिया है कि जितनी धनराशि का क्लेम वह अपने यहां उपस्थित विकलांगों के लिए करता था उससे ज्यादा विज्ञापन में खर्च कर डाला। बीबीसी लंदन सामाचार एजेंसी को भी इस बारे में बोलना पड़ा। मैं आपके माध्यम से सरकार आग्रह करता हूं कि इन जैसी संगठनों को चिहिन्त करके कठोरता से कार्रवाई की जाए, जो विदेशों में अपने विकलांगों का मजाक उड़ाने का काम कर रही है।

Title: Need to conduct new train services from Bhavnagar to Haridwar. 

डॉ. भारतीबेन डी. श्याल (भावनगर) : उपाध्यक्ष महोदय, मैं माननीय रेल मंत्री जी को धन्यवाद देता हूं कि उन्होंने पालीथाना से ब्रांदा की वीकली ट्रेन शुरू की है। यह ट्रेन एक ट्रिप लगाकर भावनगर आकर पांच दिन तक रुकी रहती है, इसका कोई यूज नहीं है। हिन्दू धर्म का हरिद्वार एक पवित्र तीर्थ स्थान है, हजारों की संख्या में लोग वहां यात्रा करते हैं। मेरे निर्वाचन क्षेत्र भावनगर और आसपास के क्षेत्रों से भी हजारों लोग हरिद्वार की यात्रा करते हैं। यह दुख की बात है कि एक भी ट्रेन आसपास के जिले से भी हरिद्वारा के लिए नहीं चलाई जाती। 

उपाध्यक्ष महोदय, मेरा आपके माध्यम से रेल मंत्री जी से अनुरोध है कि एक ट्रेन जो भावनगर में ऐसे ही पांच दिन तक रुकी रहती है, उसका यूज हो जायेगा और हजारों श्रद्धालुओं को उससे सहूलियत भी मिल जायेगी। भावनगर डिवीजन ने यह प्रपोजल रेल मंत्रालय और रेलवे बोर्ड को भेज दिया है। मेरी आपके माध्यम से रेल मंत्री जी से निवेदन है कि जल्द से जल्द भावनगर से हरिद्वार के लिए ट्रेन शुरू की जाये। बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद।
